state:
Goal `core-metrics-and-4-more`, stage of per-member feature proofs. `Core\Metrics::gauge` and
`Core\Metrics::increment` carry every proof: description, three examples, an attack, a bench with a
perf record, and a Rust test driving the member through its helper symbol. `Core\Metrics` has its
class card. `Core\Metrics::observe` already has its Rust test
(`observe_counts_every_observation_and_sums_them`) and owes its description, examples, attack and
bench. Every `Core\Metrics` write allocates 8 times a call; that is gap
`nvs-stdlib/a-metrics-write-allocates-on-every-call` (owner M12), and each metrics bench carries its
`// proof: gap` marker. Nothing is blocked.

items.text: **`Core\Metrics::observe`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/metrics.rs:168`. The `gauge` and `increment` directories are the model to copy the shape of. Its bench declares `allocations 0` and carries `// proof: gap nvs-stdlib/a-metrics-write-allocates-on-every-call`. In an attack, a step that makes many new series fills the series limit, and every later *new* name is then dropped silently, so a kind or label refusal must be asked for before that step.

backlog: The metrics write path allocates on every call, including twice per served request through `Registry::request` — gap `nvs-stdlib/a-metrics-write-allocates-on-every-call`, owner M12.

A name built at run time skips the `[a-z][a-z0-9_]*` grammar and is stored as written (an empty name, a line break), so what the exporter prints for it is not checked here — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/metrics.rs` `validate_name` doc; not checked against the exporter.
